cashFlow: Owner request -> administration approval -> registered cashbox execution -> owner receipt -> reconciliation; offset-only when net zero
standaloneBatchPrefix: MCP (independent correction source, not a sales statement)

caseReview.link: From case page, choose correction for this order; server validates branch, owner, paid source and current case version
caseReview.completion: All linked corrections rejected or fully settled, sealed allocation history and paid journals verified atomically
caseReview.financialAppealScope: Only explicitly linked MERCHANT_OWNER financial review belonging to branch owner

authorization.scope: Update case review/version/appeal metadata only in Holds; Put EXCEPTION_CASE metadata only in lifecycle queue
authorization.inlinePolicyLimit: No inline change applied; dedicated managed policy preserves identical restrictions

validation.browser: Correction-link/completion + previous case workflow, correction approval retry, net-zero offset and policy suites passed
validation.closureParity: Live effective function bodies equal local functions except new pending-correction closure guards (compiler shorthand normalized)
validation.packageWiring: Bundled routes and SDK bridges tested

limits.onLimit: Explicit blocked review, never silent completion

remaining: Ordered human acceptance in main A10; no real payout or case completion executed by deployment
